name: A Small Motion
thesis: An oversized lilac name and a real purple machine open a quiet, tactile portrait, followed by a precise slider-crank and an unfolding story about making things and helping people.
interaction: Drag the peach crank joint, turn its keyboard-accessible angle slider, or reset the mechanism. A rigid connecting rod translates the crosshead with exact slider-crank geometry.
why: Keeps the beloved image-and-type overlap and midnight-purple intimacy, adds a restrained mechanical signature, and gives makerspace teaching, VEX leadership, Stardance software, and Outpost support room alongside the printers.
